# Review checklist
- Map account-data flows
- Use HTTPS and secure configuration
- Restrict access; avoid SAD retention
- Confirm applicable validation with acquirer

Expected result: The merchant identifies its applicable obligations rather than claiming
automatic compliance.

Q: Can we claim PCI compliant just because we use a gateway?
A: No. Assess the actual integration and applicable obligations.
